acceptance: Pixel masks reviewed before similarity outcomes; no GT boxes treated as pixel visibility; mask overlap/uncertainty reported.
Same full canvas, fixed ROI coordinates, original ROI batch shape/slot and model weights. Identity image and original descriptors reproduce within1e-5.
Factorial inclusion of physical red car, physical black car, foreground occluders and remaining scene; two fixed fills (ImageNet mean and black). No selection by observed similarity.
Save normalized descriptors and independently recompute cosine distances; pure similarity and annotation-dependent ID claims kept separate.
No full tracker, neural core, model training or production edits; single GPU sequential mask then appearance jobs.
Any clock/annotation identity conflict is reported before claiming wrong physical matching; this case is diagnostic, not independent generalization.
scope: Pixel-input intervention on frozen MASA, one-case diagnostic; masks from current images are experimental annotations, not a deployable oracle-free tracker or GT visibility. Physical red/black identity is checked independently of dataset IDs.

literature.role: Kooij et al.2015: features in inaccurate detection may belong to multiple physical objects; motivates separate pixel contributions, not proof in our case.
MASA original association representation; local implementation consumes full image before ROI pooling.

refinement_before_outcomes: SAM merges overlapping cars on1164/1165. Human-reviewed conservative visible cores plus explicitly uncertain foreground, never classify all leftover object pixels as background. Masks fixed before neural similarity outcomes.
